name: @stigmer/cli
stderr:
Usage: stigmer [options] [command]

Stigmer command-line interface

Options:
  --version                            print the CLI version
  -d, --debug                          enable debug output
  --standalone                         ignore the config file; use flags and
                                       environment only
  --org <slug>                         organization slug override
  --api-key <key>                      API key for authentication
  -h, --help                           display help for command

Commands:
  version                              print the CLI version
  completion <shell>                   generate a shell completion script
                                       (bash, zsh, fish, powershell)
  config                               Manage CLI configuration
  auth                                 manage authentication with Stigmer Cloud
  apikey                               manage API keys for Stigmer Cloud
                                       authentication
  get [options] <type> <reference>     get a resource by type and reference
                                       (slug, org/slug, or ID)
  list [options] <type>                list resources of a type (or 'list
                                       types' for available types)
  search [options] <type> <query>      search resources by text query
                                       (supported types: agent, workflow)
  validate [options]                   validate resource YAML files or a plugin
                                       directory offline
  delete [options] <type> <reference>  delete a resource by type and reference
                                       (slug, org/slug, or ID)
  tag <type> <org/slug> <hash> <tag>   assign a tag to a resource version
                                       (supported types: workflow)
  share                                share resources via a hosted link
  schedule                             operate on schedules
  diff [options]                       compare local YAML with remote resource
                                       state
  usage                                view token usage and cost reports
  push [options] <type> [path]         push an artifact to the registry
                                       (supported types: skill, plugin)
  install [options] <ref>              install a plugin from a source by name:
                                       [source/]name[@version]
  marketplace                          manage the sources the Marketplace
                                       installs from: the official catalogue
                                       and the ones you add
  download [options] <type> <id>       download artifacts from an execution
  apply [options]                      apply resources from files or a plugin
                                       directory
  run [options] [type] [reference]     execute an agent or workflow by
                                       reference
  resume [options] [reference]         resume an existing session by ID
  execution                            manage execution lifecycle and
                                       observability (agent: aex_, workflow:
                                       wex_)
  connect                              connect to external services and
                                       discover capabilities
  mcp-server [options]                 start the MCP server that exposes
                                       Stigmer resources to AI coding
                                       assistants
  up [options]                         start the local Stigmer stack (server,
                                       runner, Temporal)
  bootstrap [options]                  make the configured backend ready:
                                       ensure the organization the CLI uses
                                       when none is named
  down [options]                       stop the local Stigmer stack
  status [options]                     show the status of the local Stigmer
